title: A submitted game: packages/<id>/<version>.json
description: One file per game version, added by a pull request. The CI (tools/market_tool.py ci) downloads `source`, compares `sha256`, unzips it safely and runs tools/check.py; `manifest` must equal the zip's manifest.json.

source.description: The zip's address, a GitHub release asset of your own repository: https://github.com/<you>/<repo>/releases/download/v<version>/<id>-<version>.zip (tools/market_tool.py make-zip names it).

thumb.description: Optional tile picture beside this file (the Available tab), a PNG of at most 512 kB shown in a 16:9 tile: 512 x 288 fits exactly.

notes.description: What changed in this version (for the reviewers).
